main_text.p: pulantur inuicem, hac Magnes trahit ferrum, cichoriumq; motum solis insequitur.

Hoc vehiculo & vinculo intercedente seu interueniente, Mercurius efficax est in hydrargyro, memoria & cogitatiua acuenda, vel debilitanda, alectorio lapide, colore & sapore mixto, Ægypto, Græcia, Anglia, Flandria, Silesia.

Hoc vehiculo interueniente, Luna efficax est in argento & vitris, cerebro, oculo sinistro viri, mulieris dextro, colore albo, cœruleo & cinericio, sapore falso, mediocri odore, crystallo, climate septimo, Flandria, Hollandia, Selandia, Dania.
Saturnus in plumbo, aure dextra, splene, vesica & ossibus; colore nigro, liuido, & plumbeo, sapore styptico, lapidibus nigris & obscuris, climate primo, orientis dextro; Saxonia, Stiria, &c.

Iupiter in stanno, pulmone, costis, pulsu, semine, aure sinistra, colore fusco, purpureo, flavo, viridi: Smaragdo, Sapphyro, Amethysto, sapore dulci, Climate secundo, septentrione, Babylonia, Perside, Vngaria, Hispania.
Sol in auro, corde, arteriis, oculo dextro, latere dextro: colore aureo, croceo, subruffo, hiacyntho: sapore acuto & acri, odore bono, non excedente: Climate quarto, oriente.
Mars in ferro, aure sinistra, felle, renibus: F Iaspide

page.notes: Marginal text at the left edge is cropped and belongs to the facing page; the "NB." mark is in the right margin. Some letters in the running text are blurred (e.g. "hiacyntho" with a possibly Cyrillic-like o; "Iaspide" at the foot may continue to the next page as catchword).
